title: Restrict SCHC control-wire issuance to authenticated transitions
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py exposes SchcSessionManager.issue_control_wire as a generic authority mint. Any caller holding the manager can supply arbitrary canonical ACK, ACK-REQ, Sender-Abort, or Receiver-Abort bytes plus any 32-byte peer and object; the method does not prove an authenticated reassembly/sender transition or validate key_generation against current peer state. consume_fragment_wire then accepts the manager-issued token and does not inspect the stored key_generation, bypassing the intended one-use target-bound transition policy. Remove/restrict the generic issuer and issue controls only atomically inside receipt-bound reassembly or active-sender transitions; validate current generation at consume; add forged-direct-issuance tests for unknown/stale peers and every control form.
close_reason: Fixed: consume_fragment_wire now requires looked-up key_generation current AND non-None (closed None-is-None vacuity); _issue_control_wire_unlocked rejects None at mint (fail-closed). 33 new forged-issuance tests across all 5 control forms x unknown/stale peers. 1181 schc tests pass. Follow-up filed as worker6-sppu.
